messages:
alex: heads-up: nightly bench-small-batch flagged a p95 regression, ~+22% vs baseline. perf-bot: [ALERT] job=bench-small-batch build=7631 p95=168ms baseline=138ms. link: https://dash.redwood/bench/7631

samir: can you paste the commit range? any obvious suspects?

alex: job meta: branch=main commit=4b9f1ae (prev green 3f7e12b). runtime changes in gpu-scheduler and kernel-launcher in last 4 commits.

tori: can we get a perf profile + flame? that helps rule out hot kernel change vs scheduler contention.

perf-bot: artifacts: s3://redwood-ci/bench/7631/flame.svg and s3://redwood-ci/bench/7631/perf.data

alex: quick stack from a hotspot trace:
```
runtime::GpuStreamPool::acquire()
runtime::GpuScheduler::yield_and_dispatch()
llm::TokenEmitter::emit_chunk()
```

samir: hmm yield_and_dispatch spikes. I saw a related increase in stream synchronization in yesterday's local run. might be an extra sync inserted.

tori: repro command used by nightly harness:
```
./ci/bench_small_batch --model=gpt-3-small --seq=1024 --batch=6 --iters=400 --out=artifacts/7631
```

alex: started a local reproducer on a workspace A100 box. attaching logs to incident board.

ops-bot: ephemeral node assigned: /instances/dev-a100-772 (ttl 4h)

samir: plan: 1) reproduce on 3f7e12b and 4b9f1ae, 2) perf record + DEBUG_SCHED=1, 3) toggle ASYNC_PREFETCH=off to see impact. I'll take bisect if repros.

tori: also please check kvcache metrics: /metrics/kvcache?job=7631 — if KV misses align we may be seeing backpressure from the cache layer.

alex: starting baseline now. will post numbers within 90m.

samir: if bisect points to scheduler, I can prepare a revert PR and land scheduler microtests in nightly to catch regression early.

alex: quick log excerpt from failing run shows repeated short sleeps between dispatch loops:
```
[dispatch] loop=18 waited=6.2ms sync_wait=3.4ms
[dispatch] loop=21 waited=7.0ms sync_wait=3.9ms
```

tori: that pattern screams an extra sync on the hot path. check commits touching launcher::launch_kernel and stream fences.

alex: assigning follow-ups: samir=bisect+repro (2h), tori=kv evictions + trace correlation (1h), ops=keep instance up for 4h. I'll update product infra if we need rollback.

samir: got it, starting bisect now. will ping with minimal repro and candidate PR if needed. keeping messages brief here for the handoff.
